# Aura3D CLI reference

<!-- Generated by tools/docs/gen-cli-reference.mjs from `aura3d help --json`. Do not edit by hand; run `node tools/docs/gen-cli-reference.mjs`. -->

Every command of `@aura3d/cli` (bins: `aura3d`, `aura`, `cli`), generated from the CLI's own catalog. The same text is printed by `aura3d help <command>` and `aura3d <command> --help`; `aura3d help --json` prints the catalog this page is built from. Task-oriented guides: [cli-asset-tools.md](cli-asset-tools.md) (optimise, merge clips, skin checks, fal generation, conversion) and [docs/agents/asset-workflow.md](../agents/asset-workflow.md).

Capability label: CLI asset pipeline. Commands marked **monorepo** need files from an Aura3D repository checkout; run elsewhere they stop with exit 2 and say which file is missing.

## Exit codes and global flags

| Exit | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| 0 | ok |
| 1 | the command ran and failed (failures are printed) |
| 2 | usage error, unknown command, or a monorepo-only command run outside the Aura3D repository |

- `--help`: Print the command's usage and exit 0 without running it or writing anything (also -h).
- `--version`: Print the CLI version (also -v); with --json prints {"name","version"}.
- `--json` (where a command's usage lists it): print one JSON object instead of text.

## Project, agent and deploy

<a id="aura3d-check-deploy"></a>

### `aura3d check-deploy`

Check the build output against aura.assets.json; --browser also loads routes in headless Chromium.

```text
aura3d check-deploy --dist dist [--asset assetId|--no-assets] [--source [src]] [--release] [--no-placeholders] [--require-license] [--provenance evidence.json]
aura3d check-deploy --dist dist --browser [--route /path ...] [--browser-timeout ms] [--browser-settle ms]
```

Flags: `--asset`, `--browser`, `--browser-settle`, `--browser-timeout`, `--dist`, `--no-assets`, `--no-placeholders`, `--provenance`, `--release`, `--require-license`, `--route`, `--source`.

<a id="aura3d-codemod"></a>

### `aura3d codemod`

Run a registered codemod over a file glob (renderer-imports, …).

**Monorepo:** monorepo-only for pin-emissive-defaults, animation-3.1: needs tools/codemods/pin-emissive-defaults.mjs, tools/codemods/animation-3.1.mjs from an Aura3D repository checkout.

```text
aura3d codemod <name> <glob> [--write] [--dry-run] [--report]
```

Flags: `--dry-run`, `--report`, `--write`.

<a id="aura3d-doctor"></a>

### `aura3d doctor`

Check the project's Aura3D setup and asset manifest; --look runs the look lint (aura3d look lint).

```text
aura3d doctor [--look [look lint flags]]
```

Flags: `--look`.

<a id="aura3d-examples"></a>

### `aura3d examples`

Find a working recipe or template for a task (offline) and print its source.

```text
aura3d examples <query> [--limit N] [--json] [--no-source]   best matching recipe or template; prints the top hit's complete
                                                             src/main.ts and its setup (start every new scene here)
aura3d examples --list [--json]                              every indexed example
aura3d examples --id <id> [--write src/main.ts] [--force]   one example by id; --write saves its source (a template's
                                                             src/ siblings, aura.assets.json and public/aura-assets too)
```

Flags: `--force`, `--id`, `--json`, `--limit`, `--list`, `--no-source`, `--write`.

<a id="aura3d-help"></a>

### `aura3d help`

Print help for every command, one command (aura3d help <command>) or the full catalog as JSON.

```text
aura3d help [command ...] [--json]
```

Flags: `--json`.

<a id="aura3d-import-three"></a>

### `aura3d import-three`

Bridge a three.js scene factory into a typed GLB asset, Aura3D scene source and a compatibility report.

```text
aura3d import-three <factory.mjs> [--name <key>] [--seed <n>] [--params <json>] [--out <dir>] [--stage <dir>] [--three <dir>] [--no-admit] [--license <id>] [--json]
```

Flags: `--json`, `--license`, `--name`, `--no-admit`, `--out`, `--params`, `--seed`, `--stage`, `--three`.

<a id="aura3d-info"></a>

### `aura3d info`

Installed Aura3D versions and the @aura3d/engine API surface (namespaces and members) read from the installed types; --name <export> for signatures.

```text
aura3d info [projectDir] [--json] [--members]       installed versions + @aura3d/engine API surface summary
aura3d info --name <export>[.<member>] [--json]    members and one-line signatures of one export (e.g. --name material)
```

Flags: `--json`, `--members`, `--name`.

<a id="aura3d-init"></a>

### `aura3d init`

Write agent instruction files, Aura3D agent skills and llms.txt; never overwrites user-edited files.

```text
aura3d init [--agent claude|cursor|copilot|generic|all] [--skills core|all|none] [--template <create-aura3d template>]
```

Flags: `--agent`, `--skills`, `--template`.

<a id="aura3d-render"></a>

### `aura3d render`

Build, serve and screenshot the app in headless Chrome; diagnostics JSON with errors, codes, luma/saturation and subject fill.

```text
aura3d render [projectDir] [--json] [--screenshot|--image] [--out shot.png] [--full] [--no-build] [--url http://127.0.0.1:5173/] [--route /path]
              [--dist dist] [--width N --height N --settle-ms N --ready-timeout-ms N] [--chrome <path>] [--software-gl]
  Builds (unless --no-build or --url), serves dist/, renders the app in headless Chrome and prints a short summary:
  subject framing (engine measureFrameFill on the live camera and node bounds), exposure, shadow, motion, errors, fps, backend,
  and `done` / `next`. Text by default; --json prints the same summary as JSON (stable keys, rounded numbers).
  --screenshot (or --image) also writes the PNG (to --out, default .aura3d/render.png); without it no PNG is written and a
  stale one at that path is removed. --full prints the full diagnostics report (aura3d.render/1) instead of the summary.
  When `done` is true (no errors, subject framed, exposure ok) and `aura3d validate` passes, stop: the scene is finished.
  Exit 0 when no error finding, 1 otherwise, 2 on usage error.
```

Flags: `--chrome`, `--dist`, `--full`, `--height`, `--image`, `--json`, `--no-build`, `--out`, `--ready-timeout-ms`, `--route`, `--screenshot`, `--settle-ms`, `--software-gl`, `--url`, `--width`.

<a id="aura3d-validate"></a>

### `aura3d validate`

Static checks of scene source: colours, unknown options/members/exports, invented assets, framing, lighting.

```text
aura3d validate [file.ts ... | projectDir] [--json] [--no-types] [--strict]
  Static checks: colours, unknown options/members/exports (TypeScript checker), invented asset paths and keys, framing, lighting,
  and the `aura3d verify` lint rules. Exit 0 when no error (with --strict: no error or warning), 1 otherwise, 2 on usage error.
```

Flags: `--json`, `--no-types`, `--strict`.

<a id="aura3d-verify"></a>

### `aura3d verify`

Typecheck, asset check, lint, build, serve, render in Chrome and inspect a project; emit one JSON report (--json).

```text
aura3d verify [projectDir] [--json] [--out report.json] [--skip typecheck,build,...] [--only a,b] [--route /path] [--dist dist] [--chrome <path>] [--software-gl] [--browser-lock <dir>] [--frames-dir <dir>] [--width N --height N --settle-ms N --motion-gap-ms N --timeout-ms N --ready-timeout-ms N]
aura3d verify --explain <CODE>      explain one finding code (cause and fix)
aura3d verify --list-codes          print the whole code table as JSON
```

Flags: `--browser-lock`, `--chrome`, `--dist`, `--explain`, `--frames-dir`, `--height`, `--json`, `--list-codes`, `--motion-gap-ms`, `--only`, `--out`, `--ready-timeout-ms`, `--route`, `--settle-ms`, `--skip`, `--software-gl`, `--timeout-ms`, `--width`.

## Assets

<a id="aura3d-assets-add"></a>

### `aura3d assets add`

Register a local GLB/glTF, texture, environment, audio, navigation, LUT or scalar-volume file as a typed asset with licence and provenance.

```text
Usage: aura3d assets add ./model.glb --name robot [options]
       aura3d assets add ./model.3mf --name model [options]
       aura3d assets add ./scan.nrrd --name scan --type scalar-volume
       aura3d assets add ./grade.cube --name venueGrade --type lut   (3-D .cube LUT for effects.colorGrade({ lut: assets.venueGrade }))

OBJ, PLY, STL and 3MF can be inspected with bounded native parsers. Register the
corresponding renderer-capable adapter in the app's FormatRegistry before use;
the default registry contains glTF only. Inspection does not imply full format parity.
For 3MF, use adapter id "model3mf" with extension "3mf" and Model3MFLoader.
Legacy inspection remains the default during migration. Strict rejects formats
without an available bounded parser pass, including the current metadata-only glTF path.
NRRD/NHDR scalar volumes require three spatial axes, supported scalar types and
explicit supported orientation. Detached data must be a safe local relative file.

Options:
  --type model|texture|environment|audio|navigation|lut|scalar-volume
  --model-inspection legacy|strict
  --license CC0-1.0
  --license-name "CC0 1.0 Universal"
  --license-url URL
  --license-raw TEXT
  --source-page URL
  --download-url URL
  --source-url URL
  --author NAME
  --source-family NAME
  --attribution TEXT
  --provenance-evidence TEXT (repeatable)
  --retrieved-at ISO-8601
  --quality ungraded|blocked|prototype|candidate
  --role hero|character|vehicle|enemy|world|environment|track|product|weapon|prop|set-dressing|backdrop|proxy|hdri|texture-set|vfx-atlas|audio|debug|abstract|unknown
  --suitability TEXT
  --art-direction ID (assets/art-direction/<id>.json)
  --loudness-lufs N (--type audio)
  --true-peak-db N (--type audio)
  --rendered-probe-json tests/reports/asset.probe.json
  --rendered-probe /aura-assets/probe.png
  --orientation-json tests/reports/asset.orientation.json
  --public-path /aura-assets/
  --output public/aura-assets
```

Flags: `--art-direction`, `--attribution`, `--author`, `--download-url`, `--license`, `--license-name`, `--license-raw`, `--license-url`, `--loudness-lufs`, `--model-inspection`, `--name`, `--orientation-json`, `--output`, `--provenance-evidence`, `--public-path`, `--quality`, `--rendered-probe`, `--rendered-probe-json`, `--retrieved-at`, `--role`, `--source-family`, `--source-page`, `--source-url`, `--suitability`, `--true-peak-db`, `--type`.

Admit an asset to a quality tier through the §6.4 admission gates.


<a id="aura3d-assets-bind-game-route-evidence"></a>


<a id="aura3d-assets-certify-game-geometry"></a>

### `aura3d assets certify-game-geometry`

Certify asset geometry for a game category (one asset writes the certification; --assets is read-only).

```text

aura3d assets certify-game-geometry --assets <id,id,...> --category racing|platformer|sports|fighting|arena|puzzle
```

Flags: `--asset`, `--assets`, `--category`.

<a id="aura3d-assets-convert"></a>

### `aura3d assets convert`

Convert FBX/OBJ/DAE/USD/PLY/STL/3MF/VOX/BVH to a verified GLB via Aura3D's bounded importers (partial parity, diagnostics reported).

```text
aura3d assets convert <in.fbx|.obj|.dae|.usd|.usda|.usdz|.ply|.stl|.3mf|.vox|.bvh> --out out.glb [--unit-scale N] [--up y|z] [--embed-textures] [--json]
  Converts a model (or a BVH skeleton + clip) to a self-contained GLB through Aura3D's bounded native importers, then
  re-inspects the GLB (bounds, vertices, readable materials). Partial parity: the importers convert a documented
  subset of each format and report every loss as a diagnostic; check it visually before shipping.
  --unit-scale N     multiply lengths by N after the importer's unit handling (e.g. 0.01 for centimetre OBJ/STL/PLY/BVH)
  --up y|z           source up axis for OBJ/PLY/STL/BVH (default y); FBX/DAE/USD/3MF/VOX are already converted from
                     their declared axes, so --up z there applies an extra -90 deg X correction
  --embed-textures   read external texture files (PNG/JPEG next to the source) and embed them; without it they are
                     dropped and listed (textures already inside FBX/USDZ/3MF are always kept)
  --json             print one JSON report
  Exit 0 converted and verified, 1 conversion or verification failure, 2 usage error.
  Then: aura3d assets inspect out.glb, aura3d assets add out.glb --name <key>.
```

Flags: `--embed-textures`, `--json`, `--out`, `--unit-scale`, `--up`.

<a id="aura3d-assets-export"></a>

### `aura3d assets export`

Export an Aura interchange scene with a loss report.

```text
aura3d assets export --input input.json --out path --format gltf|glb|obj|ply|stl|usdz|drc|exr|ktx2 [--binary] [--big-endian] [--external|--embed] [--encoder local-module] [--mesh N] [--primitive N] [--attachment name --layer name --compression none|rle|piz] [--encoding none|basis-etc1s|basis-uastc|zstd|zlib] [--json]
```

Flags: `--attachment`, `--big-endian`, `--binary`, `--compression`, `--embed`, `--encoder`, `--encoding`, `--external`, `--format`, `--input`, `--json`, `--layer`, `--mesh`, `--out`, `--primitive`.

<a id="aura3d-assets-generate"></a>

### `aura3d assets generate`

Generate a game-ready GLB on fal.ai (Idol: prompt or reference image, optional rig + clips), post-process and admit it as a candidate.

```text
aura3d assets generate "<prompt>" --name key [--provider idol] [--kind object|character|creature|vehicle] [--rig [--animations idle,walk,run,jump]] [--role prop|background|set-dressing|character|hero|vehicle|world|environment|weapon|enemy|product] [--size height=1.8|length=4|width=2|maxDim=2] [--front +x|-x|+z|-z] [--yaw deg] [--max-verts N] [--tex N] [--no-simplify] [--no-slim] [--seed N] [--style realistic|"<style words>"] [--out-dir assets/idol] [--no-admit] [--force] [--dry-run] [--work .aura3d/fal] [--game slug] [--key-file file] [--json]
aura3d assets generate --image ref.png --name key [same flags]
aura3d assets generate --spec idol-spec.json [--only a,b] [--concurrency 6] [--force] [--dry-run] [--no-admit] [--no-slim] [--json]
aura3d assets generate --name key --renormalize [--size ...] [--front ...] [--yaw ...] [--tex ...] [--max-verts ...] [--no-slim]   ($0: redo optimise/normalise/slim/preview from the raw downloads)
  Paid fal.ai lane: reference still (openai/gpt-image-2.6, $0.17; skipped with --image) -> speridlabs/idol/max ($0.20, $0.25 with --rig)
  -> skin refit (rigs) -> role-budget optimise -> scale/ground/face +Z -> slim normals (glossy materials keep PNG normals;
  --no-slim skips the step) -> CPU base-colour preview ->
  <out-dir>/<key>.glb + <key>.idol.json, admitted as quality "candidate" with the fal licence (skip with --no-admit).
  Key: FAL_KEY env, --key-file, ~/.config/aura3d/fal.env, ~/.config/auraone/fal.env (never printed). Every submit is ledgered
  to <work>/ledger.jsonl; a rerun resumes pending requests instead of paying twice. --dry-run prints the estimate only.
  Spec: { "game": "<slug>", "outDir": "assets/idol", "items": [ { "key": "hero", "subject": "...", "kind": "character", "rig": true, "size": { "height": 1.8 } } ] }
```

Flags: `--animations`, `--concurrency`, `--dry-run`, `--force`, `--front`, `--game`, `--image`, `--json`, `--key-file`, `--kind`, `--max-verts`, `--name`, `--no-admit`, `--no-simplify`, `--no-slim`, `--only`, `--out-dir`, `--provider`, `--renormalize`, `--rig`, `--role`, `--seed`, `--size`, `--spec`, `--style`, `--tex`, `--work`, `--yaw`.

<a id="aura3d-assets-normalize"></a>

### `aura3d assets normalize`

Turn a GLB to face +Z, scale it to a size target and ground it at y = 0 (bakes static transforms; records aura3d.orientation).

```text
aura3d assets normalize <in.glb> --out <out.glb> [--front +z|-z|+x|-x] [--yaw <deg>] [--height <m> | --length <m> | --width <m> | --max-dim <m>] [--keep-scale] [--json]
  Turns the model so its front faces +Z (+Y up), scales it to the size target, centres it in X/Z and grounds it at y = 0.
  Static meshes get the transform baked into their vertices; skinned meshes keep one `auraRoot` wrapper node.
  Records asset.extras.aura3d = { orientation: { forwardAxis: "+z", upAxis: "+y" }, grounded: true }.
  --front      axis the model currently faces (default +z = no turn; Idol humanoids usually face +x or +z)
  --keep-scale write scale 1 and report sceneScale (use for rigged files whose skin checks must see rest-length bones)
```

Flags: `--front`, `--height`, `--json`, `--keep-scale`, `--length`, `--max-dim`, `--out`, `--width`, `--yaw`.

<a id="aura3d-assets-repair-skin"></a>

### `aura3d assets repair-skin`

Repair skin weights, stretched triangles, limbs or the skeleton of a rigged GLB (every step opt-in).

```text
aura3d assets repair-skin <file.glb|assetId> [--out file.glb] [--normalize] [--max-influences 4] [--prune-distant] [--smooth-bridges] [--smooth-threshold 1.5] [--smooth-rounds 1] [--smooth-rings 4] [--cut-stretch 2] [--rebuild-limbs [--material-map skin=skin,shorts=short,socks=sock,boots=dark]] [--refit-skeleton] [--keep-clips Idle_Loop,Walk_Loop] [--json]
  Every step is opt-in; the repaired GLB is written next to the input (<name>.repaired.glb) unless --out is given, and the skin check runs again on it.
  --out FILE              where to write the repaired GLB.
  --normalize             renormalise skin weights so each vertex sums to 1.
  --max-influences N      keep the N strongest joint influences per vertex (1-4, default 4).
  --prune-distant         drop influences from joints far from the vertex.
  --smooth-bridges        smooth the weights of triangles that stretch between limbs.
  --smooth-threshold X    triangles stretched past X times their rest size form the smoothing region (default 1.5).
  --smooth-rounds N       smoothing rounds; each re-measures the stretch with the new weights (default 1).
  --smooth-rings N        rings of neighbouring vertices smoothed around a stretched triangle (default 4).
  --cut-stretch X         last resort: remove triangles still stretched past X after the other steps (leaves holes).
  --rebuild-limbs         rebuild the legs of a recognised humanoid in the pose its skeleton assumes; --material-map maps its material slots.
  --refit-skeleton        move the joints to where the mesh actually bends and re-target the clips (for a textured mesh you cannot rebuild).
  --keep-clips A,B        keep only these clips and drop the ones the game does not play.
  --json                  print the full before/after report as JSON.
```

Flags: `--cut-stretch`, `--json`, `--keep-clips`, `--material-map`, `--max-influences`, `--normalize`, `--out`, `--prune-distant`, `--rebuild-limbs`, `--refit-skeleton`, `--smooth-bridges`, `--smooth-rings`, `--smooth-rounds`, `--smooth-threshold`.

<a id="aura3d-assets-slim"></a>

### `aura3d assets slim`

Re-encode PNG normal maps (or other slots) in GLBs as JPEG q92 (shrinks files 40-60%); normal maps on glossy materials stay PNG unless --allow-glossy.

```text
aura3d assets slim <file.glb> [more.glb ...] [--quality 92] [--slots normal[,occlusion,...]] [--allow-glossy] [--out out.glb] [--json]
  Re-encodes PNG textures in the given material slots (default: normal maps) as JPEG. Rewrites files in place
  unless --out is given (single input only). A result that is not smaller than the input is not written.
  Normal maps on glossy materials (median roughness < 0.45, or metalness > 0.5) stay PNG and are
  reported as skipped: JPEG blocks show as dents in glossy reflections. --allow-glossy re-encodes them anyway.
```

Flags: `--allow-glossy`, `--json`, `--out`, `--quality`, `--slots`.

Write PNG thumbnails (CPU base-colour previews) for admitted GLB models and point the manifest at them.

```text
aura3d assets thumbnail [--asset id[,id...]] [--size 256] [--json]
  Writes <outputDir>/<id>.thumb.png for each glTF/GLB model asset (CPU base-colour preview, three-quarter view, not a
  render) and each PNG/JPEG/WebP texture (downscaled), and points the manifest thumbnailUrl at it. Other assets
  (audio, HDR, volumes, non-glTF models) are skipped; no thumbnail is made up. assets add runs this automatically.
```

Flags: `--asset`, `--json`, `--size`.

<a id="aura3d-assets-validate"></a>

### `aura3d assets validate`

Validate the manifest and typed assets; --route runs the G1–G11 admission table per referenced asset; --skin checks skinned meshes; --pbr adds PBR_* material warnings.

```text
aura3d assets validate [--asset assetId|--no-assets] [--source [src]] [--release] [--no-placeholders] [--require-license] [--provenance evidence.json] [--episode] [--pbr]
aura3d assets validate --route apps/<app> [--release]
aura3d assets validate --skin [file.glb] [--asset id[,id]] [--clips Walk,Run] [--samples 10] [--stretch-limit 1.6] [--strict] [--warn-only CODE,CODE] [--json]
  Poses every rigged GLB through the clips it ships and fails on stretched triangles (SKIN_STRETCH), thin long flaps (SKIN_FLAP), bad weights (SKIN_WEIGHT_SUM), distant influences (SKIN_WEIGHT_DISTANT), a mesh not in its skeleton's pose (SKIN_BIND_MISMATCH, warning unless --strict) and impossible joint ranges (SKIN_JOINT_RANGE).
  Known defects that ship are listed with a reason in aura.skin-allow.json.
  --pbr: decode each model's PBR maps and warn PBR_PAINT_METALLIC, PBR_NORMAL_LOSSY_GLOSSY, PBR_NORMAL_NOISY, PBR_SINGLE_MATERIAL_VEHICLE (advisory).
```

Flags: `--asset`, `--clips`, `--episode`, `--json`, `--no-assets`, `--no-placeholders`, `--pbr`, `--provenance`, `--release`, `--require-license`, `--route`, `--samples`, `--skin`, `--source`, `--stretch-limit`, `--strict`, `--warn-only`.

## Animation

<a id="aura3d-animation-generate"></a>

### `aura3d animation generate`

Generate motion-captured-quality clips from text on fal.ai (HY-Motion) and retarget them onto a rigged GLB.

```text
aura3d animation generate "<prompt>" --onto rigged.glb --out hero.glb [--name Clip] [--duration 2] [--seed 7] [--guidance 5] [--loop] [--window a,b] [--keep-turn] [--fbx] [--keep-base-animations] [--force] [--dry-run] [--work .aura3d/fal] [--game slug] [--key-file file] [--json]
aura3d animation generate --spec motion-spec.json --onto rigged.glb --out hero.glb [--only a,b] [--concurrency 8] [same flags]
  Text-to-motion on fal.ai (fal-ai/hunyuan-motion, $0.08 per clip, +$0.08 with --fbx): motion.json per clip under
  <work>/motion/<game>/<clip>/, then retargeted onto the rig with the `animation import` engine into --out.
  duration 0.5-12 s, guidance 1-10. --keep-turn keeps a clip's own turn (spins, pivots); loops cross-fade their end.
  Key: FAL_KEY env, --key-file, ~/.config/aura3d/fal.env, ~/.config/auraone/fal.env (never printed). Submits are ledgered to
  <work>/ledger.jsonl and resume from pending files without paying twice. --dry-run prints the estimate only.
  Spec: { "game": "<slug>", "onto": "rigged.glb", "outGlb": "hero.glb", "clips": [ { "key": "Run", "prompt": "...", "duration": 2, "loop": true } ] }
```

Flags: `--concurrency`, `--dry-run`, `--duration`, `--fbx`, `--force`, `--game`, `--guidance`, `--json`, `--keep-base-animations`, `--keep-turn`, `--key-file`, `--loop`, `--name`, `--only`, `--onto`, `--out`, `--seed`, `--spec`, `--window`, `--work`.

<a id="aura3d-animation-import"></a>

### `aura3d animation import`

Retarget .bvh/.fbx/.glb clips or HY-Motion motion.json onto a rigged GLB as real glTF animation clips.

```text
aura3d animation import <src> --onto rigged.glb --out hero.glb [--name Jab] [name=src[#clip] ...]
    [--clips a,b] [--map auto|map.json] [--root-motion in-place|keep|strip] [--window a,b] [--loop] [--fps 30]
    [--face-forward|--keep-turn] [--source-facing auto|+z|-z|+x|-x] [--target-facing auto|+z|-z|+x|-x]
    [--keep-base-animations] [--strict] [--dry-run] [--json]

  Retarget motion onto a rigged humanoid GLB and write real glTF animation clips.
  Sources: .bvh, .fbx, .glb/.gltf clips, HY-Motion motion.json (fal-ai/hunyuan-motion "motion_json").
  Roles are mapped automatically (named rigs and Idol's unnamed bone_N rigs); --map takes
  {"target":{"hips":"bone_0",...},"source":{...}} to override. Default root motion is in-place (vertical bob kept).
  Every clip is checked before writing (limb flips, retarget error, frozen T-pose) and the output gets
  "assets validate --skin --clips": skin defects the base rig already shows in its own clips (or that
  aura.skin-allow.json allows for the output or the admitted --onto asset) are warnings unless the new clips
  make them materially worse (new code, or > 1.5x the stretched/flap triangles); --strict fails on any
  skin error that is not allow-listed for the output. Exit 0 ok, 1 failed check, 2 usage error.
```

Flags: `--clips`, `--dry-run`, `--face-forward`, `--fps`, `--json`, `--keep-base-animations`, `--keep-turn`, `--loop`, `--map`, `--name`, `--onto`, `--out`, `--root-motion`, `--source-facing`, `--strict`, `--target-facing`, `--window`.

```text
aura3d look rubric [--genre platformer|racing|...] [--json]
```

Flags: `--genre`, `--json`.

## Evidence

<a id="aura3d-evidence-judge"></a>

### `aura3d evidence judge`

Blind A/B model judge over two folders of matched frames (Kiro Prism; a model, not a human).

```text
aura3d evidence judge --a <ref-frames-dir> --b <candidate-frames-dir> [--mode reference|sibling] [--trials 48] [--seed 20261023] [--out dir] [--model claude-sonnet-5.5] [--concurrency 3] [--subject "a browser 3D game"] [--no-judge] [--json]
```

Flags: `--a`, `--b`, `--concurrency`, `--json`, `--mode`, `--model`, `--no-judge`, `--out`, `--seed`, `--subject`, `--trials`.

## Migration

<a id="aura3d-migrate-lighting"></a>

### `aura3d migrate lighting`

PRD-02 physical-light-units codemod sweep (report mode by default).

```text
aura3d migrate lighting [dir|glob...] [--report|--write] [--out <dir>]
```

Flags: `--out`, `--report`, `--write`.

<a id="aura3d-migrate-three"></a>

### `aura3d migrate three`

Rewrite Three.js source to @aura3d/engine constructs via the T6.1 mapping table.

```text
aura3d migrate three <glob> [--write] [--report]
```

Flags: `--report`, `--write`.

## Environments

<a id="aura3d-environments-bake"></a>

### `aura3d environments bake`

Bake an environment probe asset (specular KTX2 + SH9 strip + manifest).

```text
aura3d environments bake --source room [--face-size 256] [--samples 128] [--out public/aura-environments] [--name room-neutral] [--standard-ktx2-primaries bt709|unspecified] (declares input primaries without conversion; the Aura3D probe reader currently requires BT.709)
```

Flags: `--face-size`, `--name`, `--out`, `--samples`, `--source`, `--standard-ktx2-primaries`.

## VFX

<a id="aura3d-vfx-validate-atlas"></a>

### `aura3d vfx validate-atlas`

Check a flipbook atlas JSON against the frame-grid contract

```text
aura3d vfx validate-atlas <atlas.json|manifest.json>
```

## Performance

<a id="aura3d-perf-gate"></a>

### `aura3d perf gate`

Evaluate a PRD-11 capture report against tools/perf-gate budgets (writes perf-gate.json).

**Monorepo:** monorepo-only: needs tools/perf-gate/index.mjs from an Aura3D repository checkout.

```text
aura3d perf gate --report <report.json> [--budgets <budgets.json>] [--out <perf-gate.json>] [--gate <tools/perf-gate/index.mjs>]
```

Flags: `--budgets`, `--gate`, `--out`, `--report`.

<a id="aura3d-perf-report"></a>

### `aura3d perf-report`

Build a route performance report from a perf-evidence telemetry JSON (rAF intervals).

```text
aura3d perf-report --route <id> --telemetry <telemetry.json> [--out performance-report.json]
```

Flags: `--out`, `--route`, `--telemetry`.

<a id="aura3d-core-inspect-programs"></a>

### `aura3d core inspect-programs`

Inspect the compiled-program cache reported by a saved diagnostics JSON

```text
aura3d core inspect-programs --diagnostics <path> [--json]
```

Flags: `--diagnostics`, `--json`.

Admit source audio into an sfx pack (license + loudness + transcode)

```text
aura3d sfx admit <dir> --pack <name> [--dry-run]
```

Flags: `--dry-run`, `--pack`.

## Motion evidence

<a id="aura3d-prd08-motion-report"></a>

### `aura3d prd08 motion-report`

Render the PRD-08 S9 motion-scene capture report (strips + trajectory metrics) as markdown; fails on incomplete evidence.

```text
aura3d prd08 motion-report [--report <report.json>] [--out <dir>] [--scenes <id,id>] [--engines aura3d,three]
```

Flags: `--engines`, `--out`, `--report`, `--scenes`.

## Codemods

Run with `aura3d codemod <name> <glob> [--write] [--dry-run] [--report]` (`migrate lighting` and `migrate three` are also top-level commands).

| Codemod | What it rewrites | Monorepo-only |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `animation-3.1` | 3.0 → 3.1 animation API drift: non-exact clip names at .animate/.play/resolveGLTFClipName call sites (vs the app's aura-assets clip universe), every `speed:` property (now applied), and bindRuntimeNode({applyPose}) bindings. | yes |
| `assets-route-modules` | Rewrite monolithic `src/aura-assets` imports to the route-scoped `aura-assets.route` module emitted by `assets typegen --route`. |  |
| `camera-cast` | Camera spec cast-mutations → app.camera (C-22); reports direct spec writes. |  |
| `core-v2` | Aura3D core-v2 migration: pixelRatio overrides → renderer.resolution.{maxPixelRatio\|pixelRatio}, renderer.qualityProfile → renderer.quality, safe-basic inventory rows, lights.ambient review rows |  |
| `devtools-imports` | Move devtools-destined "@aura3d/engine" imports to "@aura3d/engine/devtools" (PRD-15 T5.9). |  |
| `engine-entry-imports` | Move dispositioned "@aura3d/engine" imports to their §6.6 destination subpath (PRD-15 T5.9). |  |
| `lean-imports` | Rewrites @aura3d/lean[/(product\|game)] imports to @aura3d/engine (PRD-15 T4.7). |  |
| `look-from-ambient` | Replace bare lights.ambient() (no env/look in file) with looks.preset + TODO; drop renderer qualityProfile 'safe-basic'; move report.visualSystems consumers to report.appliedEffects |  |
| `migrate lighting` | Adopt PRD-02 physical light units: point/spot intensity → power (lumens), notes ambient>1 + environment conflicts. |  |
| `pin-emissive-defaults` | Pins legacy emissiveIntensity defaults (emissive 1.35, neon 2.8) on material.emissive(...) calls, material.neon(...) calls and emissive object literals missing the field. | yes |
| `post-v2` | Codemod for the v2 post chain: strips legacy bloom fields, rewires contactOcclusion→ambientOcclusion, deletes fxaa antiAlias, inserts the per-game output.preset, and reports emissive luma×strength < 1.0 per game. |  |
| `prd04-model-tint-report` | Report-only codemod: lists model(asset, { material }) tint sites with file, line, asset expression, color/emissive presence and followed identifier definitions for the tint decision table. |  |
| `prd09-audio-wrapper` | Route raw audio entry points through the game audio surface (PRD-09 step 5). |  |
| `prd09-capture-branches` | Remove `?capture=review` branches; keep the production arm (PRD-09 step 3). |  |
| `prd09-evidence-globals` | Move `__FOO__` window globals onto `game.evidence.legacyGlobals` (PRD-09 step 10). |  |
| `prd09-perf-script` | Drop route-local perf-report scripts for `aura3d perf-report` (PRD-09). |  |
| `prd10-world-migrate` | PRD-10 §10 migration report/rewrites: water.surface/buoyancy → world.water; cityBlock/city.block → world.street+kits.city; environments.studio → world.biome; ambient-without-env, metallic-water and route-local terrain builders (report-only). |  |
| `prd11-batch-optout` | Report-only: list nodes with runtime setMaterial( / material.roughness = mutations that need `batch: false` (PRD-11 §12.3). |  |
| `renderer-imports` | PRD-15 renderer surface consolidation: engine/rendering runtime subpaths → @aura3d/engine/renderer; A3DRenderer → Renderer; deleted wrapper methods → free functions. |  |
| `renderer-mode` | PRD-15 no-silent-fallback: remove deprecated renderer.mode/renderer.fallback option fields (CCR-15-1); report AuraRendererMode/AuraRendererFallbackMode type references for renderer.quality migration. |  |
| `vfx-pools-to-effects` | Report E25 route-local spark/burst pools and rewrite the simple patterns: effects.spawnLoop → effects.spawn; pooled primitives.box/sphere + .runtime → app.effects.burst |  |
